| [THEORY-024](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-024.md) v2 | Classical Boolean logic is restored when a presheaf of contextual data acquires a global section or is sheafified | Ghose (2025), [LIT-276](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-276.md) — asserts that the Heyting algebra of truth values "becomes Boolean" when the presheaf data collapse to a global section, and that sheaves encode Boolean reasoning. Both claims are asserted, not proved. The record's readings refute them. The internal logic of a topos is fixed by the base category and its topology, not by whether one presheaf has a section (Isham–Butterfield, [LIT-325](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-325.md), §6). Sheaf toposes such as Sh(ℝ) are not Boolean ([NOTE-249](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-249.md)). The contextuality criterion itself is untouched. | Rejected |
| [THEORY-035](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-035.md) v5 | Deep networks generalise because the diffusion phase of SGD compresses each layer's information about the input | Shwartz-Ziv & Tishby (2017), [LIT-324](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-324.md), report a fitting phase followed by a long compression phase in the information plane, and read compression by gradient diffusion as the mechanism of generalisation. | [THEORY-765](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-765.md) v2 | Brushing a seen rubber hand in synchrony with the hidden real hand makes touch be felt at the rubber hand, makes it be reported as one's own, and shifts the felt position of the real hand toward it; a small asynchrony removes these effects | Botvinick & Cohen (1998), [LIT-1277](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1277.md), read in full in [NOTE-1006](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1006.md). Ten subjects affirmed referred touch and ownership after ten minutes of synchronous brushing; after thirty minutes their blind reaches drifted toward the rubber hand in proportion to how long the illusion was reported; asynchronous brushing cut both. It does not show that synchrony alone, apart from expectation, produces the report, and it concerns a hand, not the whole body or the self. | Rejected — Rejected on 2026-10-20 by its own refutation condition: drift toward the rubber hand appeared as strongly under asynchronous brushing interrupted by pauses, and with the hand only seen (Rohde et al. 2011, LIT-1281).
